description: Finnish real property and housing law: conveyance of real property and registration of title (maakaari 540/1995), sale of housing-company shares and defect liability (843/1994), housing-company maintenance and governance (1599/2009) and residential and commercial leases.

interface.longDescription: Finnish real estate and housing law: the prescribed form of a conveyance of real property, the registrations and liability for defects (maakaari 540/1995), the sale of a dwelling with the RS system and notices of defect (843/1994), the maintenance liability and governance of a housing company (1599/2009), and leases of residential and business premises with their differences in mandatory force.
